subject: Temporary slot realignment until capacity rebalancing — ClearPay impact
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@clearpay.com>
To: connor.obrien@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@clearpay.com
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Sudden throughput drop & elevated p50/p95 — looking for immediate help

Connor —

We're seeing a sustained ~40% drop in effective QPS against our reserved pool starting ~08:40 PST this morning. Token latency p50 jumped from ~55ms -> 180ms and p95 is spiking into the 600-800ms range. We're also seeing a small but growing 5xx percentage (mostly 502/504) in the last 20 minutes.

This is on a production route (model: rwinference/rlm-large:202706) that is backed by our reserved capacity. We confirmed no code deploys on our side. Attached is a short QPS/time graph showing the deviation.

Can Redwood temporarily realign slots or provide a short-term throughput fallback until you rebalance the pool? We need an ETA on mitigation and visibility into whether we'll receive credits for missed reservation guarantees.

Priority: high for ClearPay ops/merchant experience.

Thanks,
Alice Nguyen
Sr. SRE, ClearPay
ops+infra@clearpay.com

Attachments: qps_graph.png (image/png)
From: connor.obrien@redwood.com <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, soojin.lee@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: alice.nguyen@clearpay.com
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2027 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden throughput drop & elevated p50/p95 — looking for immediate help

Marissa / Soojin / Jonas — looped in.

Thanks Alice — we're on it. Soojin, can you triage the ClearPay pool (reserved-id CLP-2027-0894) and confirm if there is noisy neighbor contention, KV-cache pressure, or kernel degradation? If we can't quickly rebalance, we should propose a temporary slot realignment (move 6 slots from non-critical lifts to the ClearPay pool) and present an ETA.

Marissa — I'll need sales to coordinate the credit conversation with procurement and confirm the MAP (mutual_action_plan.docx) that keeps ClearPay functional while we stabilize.

I'll drive ops coordination; can someone confirm whether burst authorization is possible under the current contract or if procurement needs to sign off?

Connor O'Brien

Redwood Inference

Subject: ClearPay — customer impact summary & immediate asks

Team — short note with asks so we can move fast.

Customer impact summary: ClearPay is a top-tier reserved customer (annual commitment, SLAs tied to reserved throughput). They're reporting p50/p95 latency regressions and a throughput deficit affecting checkout flows. This is material to their merchant SLAs and will impact the renewal conversation if not quickly mitigated.

Immediate asks (please action in order):
1) Ops (Soojin): quick triage + recommended mitigation for next 60m (slot realignment or kernel rollback).
2) Engineering (Jonas): if KV-cache pressure, provide an estimated time to run a hot-cache rebalance or config patch.
3) Sales/Account (Connor & Marissa): confirm a short-term credit posture we can promise to procurement and whether we can authorize 2 hours of burst at no charge as a goodwill measure.
4) Procurement (ClearPay): please acknowledge whether you can sign the temporary MAP (attached) that documents the steps and the credit arrangement.

I attached a proposed mutual action plan (mutual_action_plan.docx) we can send to procurement with checkboxes for sign-off. I'll keep execs updated if we see cross-region spillover.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2027 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearPay — early diagnostics (logs attached)

Soojin — early findings attached. We're seeing KV cache growing steadily for that model in the affected pool, and a subset of hosts are reporting higher GPU memory fragmentation leading to slower kernel dispatch. The pattern looks like a spine of noisy tails rather than a single host OOM.

Short actions I recommend:
- Immediate: redistribute cached prefixes across hosts (quick rebalance script) to reduce per-host cache pressure (10-15 min).
- Near term (30-90 min): kernel resync roll (restart of the inference worker on 5/32 hosts in the pool) to recover dispatch latency.
- Medium term: adjust sequence-length padding heuristics for this customer's workload and consider a quantization profile test later today.

I've attached a small diagnostic extract (kv-cache-diagnostic.txt) with per-host cache sizes and eviction stats. If ops executes the immediate step I'll stand by for the resync window.

-Jonas
Head of Runtime Engineering — Redwood Inference

Attachments: kv-cache-diagnostic.txt (text/plain)

Subject: Re: ClearPay — mitigation plan and authorization request

Quick status and recommended play:

Triage summary (09:50–14:10):
- Confirmed KV-cache pressure in pool CLP-2027-0894; top 6 hosts showing elevated eviction rates.
- No noisy tenant sprawl detected outside ClearPay (other tenants stable).
- GPU dispatch jitter correlated with memory fragmentation on a host subset.

Immediate mitigation (can start now):
1) Execute quick rebalance of KV prefixes across pool (estimated 12 minutes).
2) If rebalance does not reduce p95 under 400ms within 20 minutes, perform a staggered worker restart on 6 hosts (estimated 25 minutes total, rolling to keep capacity).
3) Apply soft app-layer rate-limiting for ClearPay checkout route (reduce burst factor by 20%) as a temporary guardrail — requires ClearPay acknowledgement.

Authorization ask (for procurement/sales):
- Approve temporary slot realignment: move up to 6 slots from non-critical pools into CLP-2027-0894 for up to 4 hours. This is an internal capacity shift, not an extra spend, but requires exec/ops approval.
- If realignment is not acceptable, request approval to open a burst window (2 hours) and commit to issuing a credit for the missed reservation guarantees.

I can kick off actions 1+2 immediately once Connor confirms internal approval; I'll send progress updates every 10 minutes.

Soojin Lee
Principal SRE — Redwood Inference

- Authorization: ops-approved slot realignment starting 16:20 PST (6 slots) for up to 4 hours.
- If p95 does not drop below 400ms within 30 minutes of the rebalance completing, we will perform the staggered worker restarts and open a 2-hour burst window.
- Credit posture: Redwood will auto-issue a reservation credit prorated for the window if we fail the guaranteed reserved throughput; procurement, no claim needed. I'll follow up with a short MAP acceptance message you can sign.

I'll post a final summary when the mitigation completes.

Connor O'Brien
